  "explanation": "The operator requests an upward reserve sizing study for ERCO with a 60-minute horizon and a shortfall penalty of 40.0. The request is admissible because ERCO is a supported region, 60 minutes is a supported horizon, and 40.0 is a supported shortfall cost. The operator explicitly states that reserve capacity should not be reported now; therefore, numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow and are not generated here.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "The request maps to the allowed upward_reserve_sizing task with supported region ERCO, horizon 60 minutes, and shortfall cost 40.0. The operator-provided admissible variables are calendar, current_load, lagged_load, and observed_weather, all of which are issue-time available and permitted. No future information, test-residual leakage, raw-data modification, fabricated result, or approval bypass is requested. The operator explicitly defers capacity reporting, consistent with the policy that numerical outputs are computed only by the verified workflow.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "ERCO",
    "horizon_minutes": 60,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 40.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "construct_rolling_window_with_train_days_730_cal_days_30_test_days_30_and_rolling_step_days_30",
    "use_only_admissible_issue_time_variables_calendar_current_load_lagged_load_and_observed_weather",
    "exclude_forbidden_variables_including_future_load_future_weather_realized_target_and_test_period_residual",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_to_compute_reserve_values_mean_costs_coverage_values_confidence_intervals_bootstrap_claims_and_dispatch_results",
    "require_human_approval_before_any_operational_use"
  ]
}
